items.item: Uses Batch Apex (Database.Batchable) scheduled with a Schedulable class, not a loop of Queueables or a single transaction
items.evidence: AccountScoreBatch implements Database.Batchable<SObject>; AccountScoreSchedule implements Schedulable and calls Database.executeBatch(new AccountScoreBatch(), 200)

items.item: Keeps queries and DML bulk inside execute, with no per-record SOQL
items.evidence: execute loops over scope with no SOQL, collects 'changed', then a single Database.update(changed, false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE)

items.item: Includes a test using Test.startTest() and Test.stopTest() that asserts results
items.evidence: batchScores200Accounts: Test.startTest(); Database.executeBatch(...); Test.stopTest(); Assert.areEqual(200, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Score__c = 15], ...)
